text:
maya: Quick UX/engineering check: should saved per-route analytics views default to re-resolving routing rules or replaying the exact routing that existed when saved?

eli: Re-resolve by default. People expect dashboards to reflect current infra. But we should record the original routing metadata for replay/forensics.

frank: Agreed. Implementation idea: saved view stores optional expected_routing (policy_id, model_hashes, region_hint). Loading shows mode selector: Active (default) or Exact (advanced).

maya: UX: small header pill "mode: active" that you can toggle to "exact". If exact fails (missing policy/model), show a banner explaining fallback and what changed.

eli: Telemetry: emit console_view_opened with fields (view_id, mode, resolved_policy, resolved_models, sample_rate). That lets cost estimates match what users actually saw.

frank: API sketch for save endpoint: POST /api/console/views body includes name, scope, target_id, filters, optional expected_routing (policy_id, model_hashes). Response 201 { view_id }. Also log audit entry when expected_routing present.

maya: Permission note: only route-admin/policy-admin can pin policy_id. Others can include model hints but not pin policies (return 403 on attempt).

ux-bot: Canary scheduled: savedview-replay-toggle -> deploy window 2026-04-05T04:00:00Z.
